Your trusted partner across Burnley and the North West

Decorating & Plastering Experts
You Can Rely On

Tired paintwork and tired walls drag a property down. We help you fall back in love with your home by delivering flawless decorating and plastering, on time and with zero mess.

Get Your Free Quote Today
Or call us now

A Local Renovations Company Built On Experience

From the moment Matthew Anderson picked up a paintbrush as an apprentice, he knew quality craftsmanship mattered.

After winning a CITB SkillBuild competition, earning an NVQ Level 3 in Painting & Decorating and completing a foundation degree in construction, he honed his plastering skills working for property developers. Today that experience informs everything we do. We listen carefully, advise honestly, and refuse to cut corners – so your project is finished to a standard you’re proud of.

Our Decorating & Plastering Services

Interior Painting & Decorating

High-quality interior decorating for homes and properties of all sizes. We handle full room redecorations, feature walls, colour changes and fine finishing, always with careful preparation and clean, sharp results.

Exterior Painting & Decorating

Protect and refresh the outside of your property with durable exterior finishes. We paint masonry, render, woodwork and metalwork, helping your building look its best and stand up to the weather.

Plastering & Wall Repairs

Professional plastering services including skim coating, re-skimming, patch repairs and ceiling finishes. We also repair cracked, damaged or uneven surfaces to leave walls smooth and ready for decoration.

Plasterboard, Ceilings & Structural Prep

Installation and repair of plasterboard, ceiling repairs and preparation works. This includes filling, sanding and surface preparation to make sure everything beneath the paint or plaster is done properly.

Damp, Mould & Affected Wall Repairs

Treatment of mould issues and repairs to damp-affected walls following treatment. We don’t just cover problems up – we fix the damage and give clear advice to help prevent it coming back.

Property Refresh & Maintenance Decorating

Reliable decorating and plastering for landlords, estate agents, care homes and commercial properties. This includes end-of-tenancy redecoration, property refreshes, ongoing maintenance and minor repair works related to decorating and plastering.

Learn More About My Services

Trusted By Property Managers & Housing Associations

If you manage multiple properties, you need a partner who turns up when promised, works cleanly and keeps tenants happy. Our team understands the pressures of maintaining housing stock. We offer:

  • Responsive maintenance decorating and plastering
  • End‑of‑tenancy refreshes that minimise void periods
  • Damp and mould treatment with clear advice on prevention
  • Flexible scheduling around tenants and care‑home residents
  • Clear, itemised pricing with no hidden extras

Domestic Decorating Services

Every home deserves to feel special. Whether it’s a full renovation or a single feature wall, we take the same care with preparation, protection and finish. From contemporary neutrals to bold statement colours, we’ll guide you through options and leave you with a space that reflects your style.

Find Out More About Domestic Services

Trusted by Landlords & Property Managers

Landlords and property managers need work that’s tidy, reliable and done on schedule. We regularly carry out decorating and plastering for rental properties, managed portfolios and shared buildings, keeping spaces presentable and ready for use.

Work is planned to reduce downtime, carried out with care, and finished to a standard that makes properties easier to let, manage and maintain.

View Property & Landlord Services

What Sets Us Apart

Trade Background
& Qualifications

Matthew began his career in a traditional apprenticeship, went on to win a CITB SkillBuild award and holds an NVQ Level 3 plus a foundation degree in construction.

Clear Pricing
& Honest Advice

We offer fixed quotes wherever possible, so you know what you’re paying. If a day rate is more sensible, we’ll explain why – and keep you informed as work progresses.

Jobs That
Move

We don’t like lingering on site any more than you do. Through careful planning and years of experience, we work efficiently without ever rushing the finish.

Fully Insured
& Respectful

We’re fully insured for your peace of mind. We protect your floors and furniture, tidy up at the end of each day and treat your property as if it were our own.

Why Choose Ascend Building Renovations

Choosing the right decorator or plasterer means trusting the person doing the work and feeling confident the job will be done properly. Here’s what sets Ascend Building Renovations apart.

  • Proven Trade Experience:
    With over 15 years of hands-on experience, we’ve worked on a wide range of decorating and plastering projects, from single rooms to full refurbishments.
  • Award-Winning Background:
    Matthew started his career through a traditional apprenticeship and went on to win a CITB SkillBuild competition, recognising skill and attention to detail.
  • NVQ Level 3 Qualified:
    Fully qualified in Painting and Decorating, giving reassurance that work is carried out to recognised trade standards.
  • Foundation Degree in Construction
    A strong construction background means we understand more than just the finish. We know what needs to be right underneath too.
  • Clear, Fixed Pricing:
    Most work is quoted at a fixed price so you know what to expect. Day rates are only used when the scope genuinely can’t be defined upfront.
  • Quality Materials Used:
    We use trusted products and proven methods to deliver finishes that look good and last.
  • Clean and Respectful Working:
    Floors and furniture are protected, work areas are kept tidy, and we clean up properly when the job is complete.
  • Flexible Scheduling:
    We plan work around your home, tenants or business and keep you informed from start to finish.
  • Mould and Damp Repair Knowledge:
    Affected areas are repaired properly, with clear advice given to help prevent issues returning.
  • Local Coverage:
    Based in Burnley and covering Southport and the wider North West, we’re happy to travel for the right job.
Find Out More About Us

Areas We Cover

Based in Burnley, we happily travel throughout the North West – including Southport, Preston, Blackburn, Manchester and surrounding areas. If you’re unsure whether we cover your location, just ask.

Contact us today

Hear From Our Happy Customers

“We had mould issues in a bedroom and were really impressed with how thoroughly it was dealt with. The room now looks brand new and we were given clear advice on prevention going forward.”
Andrew
“Matthew and his team transformed our lounge and dining room. They were prompt, tidy and the finish was exceptional. We’ll definitely use them again.”
Sarah
